claims: Stingray on Season 14 of The Masked Singer was revealed to be Evan Ross.
Evan Ross is an actor and musician.
Evan Ross is the son of Diana Ross.
Diana Ross is a Motown legend.
The revelation of Stingray as Evan Ross occurred in a double-elimination episode on March 18, 2026.
Evan Ross is known for his roles in 90210.
Evan Ross is known for his roles in The Hunger Games.
Evan Ross performed "Starboy" by The Weeknd before his unmasking.

Stingray clues indicated his connection to Michael Jackson as his godfather.
Stingray clues pointed to his acting career.

Evan Ross was eliminated alongside 14 Karat Carrot.
14 Karat Carrot was Judge Greg Mathis.
Evan Ross described the experience as fun.
